approach: Static recompilation of the 3DS binary: the game's ARM11 code is translated from the player's own dump into C (in-repo arm2c translator) and built as a native PC program with a hand-written Vulkan/SDL2 runtime and launcher
notes: Completed end-to-end on Linux without issue, at 60 fps: title intro, Mii sign-up, the trial flights (plane, rocket belt, hang glider), Mission Flight, Free Flight, saving and sound, with keyboard, mouse and gamepad input. PC additions include up to 4x 3D resolution, anisotropic filtering, FSR 1/FXAA/sharp scaling, switchable screen layouts, longer draw distance and free look. Releases are build kits (launcher and tools) for Linux and Windows — the game is compiled locally from the player's own dump and no game code or data is included. No macOS build and no stereoscopic 3D; the Windows build is the newer of the two, and reports from Windows players are welcome.
